notes.title: Game release
notes.content: [p]Mate in Eleven is now available to play.[/p][p][/p][p]It has been a long journey up until this point, and I want to convey my heartfelt gratitude to the people that supported me along the way.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope that this game provides the tactical scenery that you might be searching for, and that you'll be able to find the edge that you need to climb the ranked ladder.[/p][p][/p][p]I will be here to address any bugs during launch weekend, and to address any server issues. (Please be gentle).[/p][p][/p][p]Please enjoy.[/p][p]@bbsify[/p]
